lastResponse.text: Yes. Fastest next step: call 5 4 1 … 2 7 0 … 1 0 0 5 now and say, “I need emergency shelter tonight and transport, with my child.” That line is for overnight warming shelters (Lincoln City and Newport), and transport is available. No documents required. If you’re nearer Florence, call 5 4 1 … 3 9 3 … 8 5 5 2. You can share only what you want. If he appears, call 9 1 1.
